problem_parameters.num_zones: <int> Number of spatial zones in the power grid.
problem_parameters.num_weeks: <int> Number of representative subperiods (weeks) in the planning year.
problem_parameters.hours_per_subperiod: <int> Number of consecutive hours in each subperiod (always 168).
problem_parameters.total_hours: <int> Total number of hourly time steps across all subperiods.
problem_parameters.num_generator_clusters: <int> Total number of generation and storage resource clusters across all zones.
problem_parameters.num_UC_generators: <int> Number of resource clusters subject to unit commitment constraints.

released_investment_convention.uc_power_increment: <str, fixed value 'generator.capacity_size_MW'> UC investment counts physical generator blocks.
released_investment_convention.non_uc_power_increment_MW: <float, fixed value 1> Non-UC investment counts integer MW increments rather than physical cluster units.
released_investment_convention.uc_storage_energy_increment: <str, fixed value 'generator_parameters.<type>.energy_capacity_size_MWh'> UC storage energy uses its physical energy block.
released_investment_convention.non_uc_storage_energy_increment_MWh: <float, fixed value 1> Non-UC storage energy investment counts integer MWh increments.
released_investment_convention.transmission_increment_MW: <float, fixed value 1> MILP transmission expansion counts integer MW increments.
released_investment_convention.transmission_max_capacity_semantics: <str, fixed value 'total_capacity_after_expansion'> transmission max_capacity_MW bounds final total line capacity.
released_investment_convention.milp_investment_variables_are_integer: <bool, fixed true> All released MILP investment-count variables are integral.

policy.type: <str> Policy scenario identifier (REF, RPS, or CO2).
policy.description: <str> Human-readable description of the active policy scenario.
policy.RPS_share: <float> Minimum fraction of total weighted demand that must be met by RPS-qualifying generation.
policy.CO2_cap_tons_per_MWh: <float> CO2 emissions cap expressed as tons per MWh of total weighted demand.
policy.RPS_noncompliance_cost_per_MWh: <float> Penalty cost per MWh of shortfall below the RPS target.
policy.CO2_noncompliance_cost_per_ton: <float> Penalty cost per ton of CO2 emissions exceeding the cap.

subperiod_weights: <list[float], length num_weeks> Weight of each subperiod reflecting how many weeks of the year it represents.
generators: <list[object], length num_generator_clusters> List of resource cluster definitions, each containing the fields below.

generators[*].cluster_id: <int> Unique identifier for this resource cluster.
generators[*].zone: <int> Zone in which this resource cluster is located.
generators[*].resource_type: <str> Technology type of the resource (e.g., natural_gas_CC, solar, battery, hydro).
generators[*].is_UC: <bool> Whether this cluster is subject to unit commitment constraints.
generators[*].is_VRE: <bool> Whether this cluster is a variable renewable energy resource.
generators[*].is_storage: <bool> Whether this cluster is a battery storage resource.
generators[*].is_hydro: <bool> Whether this cluster is a hydropower resource.
generators[*].is_RPS_qualifying: <bool> Whether generation from this cluster counts toward the renewable portfolio standard.
generators[*].can_retire: <bool> Whether existing units in this cluster may be retired.
generators[*].capacity_size_MW: <float> Physical power capacity of one cluster unit in MW; it is the investment block only for UC resources under released_investment_convention.

<resource_type>.capacity_size_MW: <float> Power capacity of one unit in MW.
<resource_type>.min_output_frac: <float> Minimum generation output as a fraction of committed capacity.
<resource_type>.ramp_up_rate_pct_per_hr: <float> Maximum hourly increase in output as a fraction of capacity.
<resource_type>.ramp_down_rate_pct_per_hr: <float> Maximum hourly decrease in output as a fraction of capacity.
<resource_type>.min_up_time_hr: <int> Minimum number of consecutive hours a unit must remain online after starting.
<resource_type>.min_down_time_hr: <int> Minimum number of consecutive hours a unit must remain offline after shutting down.
<resource_type>.variable_cost_per_MWh: <float> Variable operating cost per MWh of generation.
<resource_type>.fixed_OM_cost_per_MW_yr: <float> Annual fixed operations and maintenance cost per MW of installed capacity.
<resource_type>.investment_cost_per_MW_yr: <float> Annualized capital cost per MW for building new capacity.
<resource_type>.start_up_cost: <float> Cost incurred each time a unit is started up.
<resource_type>.CO2_emission_tons_per_MWh: <float> CO2 emissions in tons per MWh of generation.
<resource_type>.max_capacity_MW: <float> Maximum total new capacity in MW that can be built for this resource type per zone.

battery.capacity_size_MW: <float> Power capacity of one battery unit in MW.
battery.energy_capacity_size_MWh: <float> Energy capacity of one battery unit in MWh.
battery.charging_efficiency: <float> Fraction of withdrawn energy that is stored when charging.
battery.discharging_efficiency: <float> Fraction of stored energy that is delivered when discharging.
battery.self_discharge_rate_pct: <float> Fraction of stored energy lost per hour due to self-discharge.
battery.min_duration_MWh_per_MW: <float> Minimum ratio of energy capacity to power capacity in MWh per MW.
battery.max_duration_MWh_per_MW: <float> Maximum ratio of energy capacity to power capacity in MWh per MW.
battery.variable_cost_per_MWh: <float> Variable operating cost per MWh of storage throughput.
battery.fixed_OM_cost_per_MW_yr: <float> Annual fixed operations and maintenance cost per MW of installed power capacity.
battery.investment_cost_per_MW_yr: <float> Annualized capital cost per MW of new power capacity.
battery.energy_investment_cost_per_MWh_yr: <float> Annualized capital cost per MWh of new energy capacity.
battery.energy_fixed_OM_cost_per_MWh_yr: <float> Annual fixed energy-side O&M cost per installed MWh; explicitly zero in the released data.
battery.max_capacity_MW: <float> Maximum total new power capacity in MW that can be built.
battery.max_energy_capacity_MWh: <float> Maximum total new energy capacity in MWh that can be built.
battery.CO2_emission_tons_per_MWh: <float> CO2 emissions in tons per MWh of storage throughput.

hydro.capacity_size_MW: <float> Power capacity of one hydro unit in MW.
hydro.min_output_frac: <float> Minimum combined generation and spillage as a fraction of power capacity.
hydro.duration_MWh_per_MW: <float> Fixed ratio of reservoir energy capacity to power capacity in MWh per MW.
hydro.variable_cost_per_MWh: <float> Variable operating cost per MWh of hydro generation.
hydro.fixed_OM_cost_per_MW_yr: <float> Annual fixed operations and maintenance cost per MW of installed capacity.
hydro.investment_cost_per_MW_yr: <float> Annualized capital cost per MW for building new hydro capacity.
hydro.energy_investment_cost_per_MWh_yr: <float> Hydro reservoir energy investment cost per MWh; explicitly zero in the released data.
hydro.energy_fixed_OM_cost_per_MWh_yr: <float> Hydro reservoir fixed O&M cost per MWh; explicitly zero in the released data.
hydro.CO2_emission_tons_per_MWh: <float> CO2 emissions in tons per MWh of hydro generation.
hydro.max_capacity_MW: <float> Maximum total new hydro capacity in MW that can be built.

existing_capacity: <dict, key: '{cluster_id}'> Pre-existing installed power capacity in MW for each resource cluster.
demand: <dict, key: '{zone}'> Hourly electricity demand in MWh for each zone, as a list of length total_hours.
consumer_segments: <list[object]> Non-served energy segments defining curtailment tiers per zone.

consumer_segments[*].zone: <int> Zone to which this segment applies.
consumer_segments[*].max_nse_fraction: <float> Maximum fraction of zonal hourly demand that may go unserved in this tier.
consumer_segments[*].cost_per_MWh: <float> Penalty cost per MWh of unserved energy in this tier.

transmission_lines: <list[object]> Inter-zonal transmission lines connecting pairs of zones.

transmission_lines[*].line_id: <int> Unique identifier for this transmission line.
transmission_lines[*].from_zone: <int> Zone at one end of the transmission line.
transmission_lines[*].to_zone: <int> Zone at the other end of the transmission line.
transmission_lines[*].existing_capacity_MW: <float> Pre-existing transfer capacity of the line in MW.
transmission_lines[*].max_capacity_MW: <float> Maximum total capacity the line can reach after expansion in MW.
transmission_lines[*].investment_cost_per_MW_yr: <float> Annualized capital cost per MW of new transmission capacity.

availability: <dict, key: '{cluster_id}'> Hourly availability factor (0 to 1) for each resource cluster, as a list of length total_hours.
hydro_inflow: <dict, key: '{cluster_id}'> Hourly normalized inflow fraction for each hydro cluster, as a list of length total_hours.
